echo: Tell me about your work, but keep it brief.

lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
lines.text: Ah, well, 'tis mostly shoeing horses and hammering out iron for the ploughs and carts around these parts.

lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron wipes soot from his brow with the back of a callused hand.*
